## PR 本文 (原文復旧 — devin-ef68464d)

## Summary

REV32-SYSTEM: the optimization/system surfaces had almost no explanations — hovering any field or column gave the user nothing. This PR adds Japanese tooltips + WhatsThis text to every interactive control, and per-column header tooltips to every tree/table, so each item explains its meaning, units, and valid values.

| Surface | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Optimization workspace (search/candidates/comparison/interventions/robustness/validation tabs) | ~8 tooltips total | ~70 controls + 13 trees' column headers explained in JA |
| Prediction dock | 2 tooltips | all fields, prediction tree, matrix table explained |
| Joint optimization panel | 8 tooltips | all controls + DSP bound spins + spec columns |
| Capture receiver settings | 0 tooltips | pairing offer/confirm/scope/port/device list explained |
| Intervention planner / field explorer / seat priority / robustness authoring / standards workspace | 0–4 each | every field and every column header explained |

Details:
- `OptimizationWorkflowController._apply_help_tooltips()` — one method holding a `dict[QWidget, str]` for ~70 controls plus `dict[int, str]` column tooltips for 13 trees (applied via `headerItem().setToolTip`).
- Campaign/validation fields carry their real units: residual = 実測RMS誤差 (dB), sensitivity = dB/m, band low/high = Hz, GP length scale = m.
- Per-`code` tooltips for `campaign_applicability_state`/`detail` table cells.
- Regression test `test_rev32_controls_and_column_headers_have_japanese_explanations` asserts every listed widget has a non-ASCII (JA) tooltip and every column header of the 12+ trees is explained.

## GUI verification

Real-GUI run (Mesa llvmpipe): hovering the 名前 field shows its explanation; hovering the 最大 column header shows 探索範囲の上限(m).
